method: Manual inspection of each listed full-resolution frozen WebP using view_image(detail=original). No crop, resize, conversion, decoding, capture, or interaction was performed by this reviewer. conclusion: No exposed private card face was observed in any represented source frame. The native-ready hand is outside the visible content, so no positive native-hand concealment or continuous privacy claim is made.
